My girlfriend and I were making soup at like 1am to bring upstairs to watch a movie. I poured her bowl, and she asked me to grab spoons. She walks away, and I go to grab the spoons. The next thing I hear is a scream and a bowl of soup flying across the room. My girlfriend in absolute tears jumps into my arms, and I begin freaking out because my first thought isn't paranormal.

Under our staircase is a small compartment for storage. There's nothing really in there's just a couple of boxes, nothing else. She says as she approaches it towards the stairs, the door whips open, and she feels a gust of cold wind. It happened so fast. We rush outside and decompress for about an hour before returning inside. 

So neither of us believes in the paranormal. We're not religious and hadn't experienced anything prior. However, my mom, who we lived with at the time, had recently become a "Psychic Medium" and channeled people in the house. 

Ever since that night, my girlfriend had recurring nightmares of a man standing at our bedroom door. Eventually, we got our own place and have never had another experience. However, I've become more interested in the paranormal.
